name: Swiss International Pro

motion.name: Hover Underline

The hero is a flush-left Helvetica-class headline in #111111 spanning eight columns, with a small red index numeral 01 beside it and a paragraph of gray #6B6B6B body text locked to a hard left edge. ROLE: You are a senior front-end engineer building a one-page agency portfolio in the Swiss International Pro style — grid-obsessed, typographic, ruthlessly aligned.
LOOK: Palette — bg #FAFAF8, surface #FFFFFF, fg #111111, muted #6B6B6B, accent #E30613, accent2 #1A1A1A, border #E3E3DF, no gradient. Load fonts via https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter+Tight:wght@500;700;800&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap — Inter Tight for display, Inter for body, IBM Plex Mono for metadata. Everything flush left; no centered text anywhere except the CTA band.
LAYOUT: Build in order: (1) sticky top nav — wordmark left, five mono uppercase links right, 1px #E3E3DF bottom border; (2) hero — 4px red rule, mono kicker, 8-column-clamped Inter Tight headline, gray lede, two buttons; (3) stats band — four columns with oversized numerals and mono labels; (4) feature grid — three white cards on hairline borders with index numerals 01/02/03; (5) about — two flush-left paragraphs; (6) CTA band; (7) footer-mega — four columns of mono links.
MOTION: Use GSAP ScrollTrigger: red rules scale-x 0-100% in 500ms cubic-bezier(0.77,0,0.18,1); headlines split-line reveal, 80ms stagger, 600ms each; sections scroll-snap (CSS scroll-snap-type: y proximity); nav underline grows 200ms ease-out.
SIGNATURE: A toggleable 12-column grid overlay button (shows semi-transparent red columns); oversized index numerals set in Inter Tight 800 at 4rem.
CONSTRAINTS: Semantic HTML (header/main/section/footer), responsive single-column under 720px, WCAG AA contrast (#E30613 only on white/light surfaces), no layout shift, defer JS, total under 150KB.

name: Bauhaus Revival

tagline: Primary geometry, honest structure, zero ornament.

📘 Handbook / 🧭 Getting started

🧭 Getting started at Fieldnotes

Welcome! This handbook is the single source of truth for how we work. It is alive — if something is stale, fix it the moment you notice. That's the whole culture in one sentence.

💡 Everything here is editable by everyone. Blank pages are bugs; wrong pages are worse bugs.

📖 How we write things down

Decisions live in pages, not in chat scrollback. Any discussion that ends with a choice gets a /decision page with context, options, and the call. Two paragraphs beats an hour of re-explaining.

  • ✅ Write the page before the meeting
  • ✅ Link every claim to its source
  • ✅ Date-stamp anything time-sensitive

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Roles, loosely held

People wear hats: 🧭 guide✍️ editor🔧 builder. Hats rotate quarterly. Nobody owns a page forever — the wiki outlives all of us.

🚢 Shipping checklist

Before anything goes to the community: docs updated, changelog written, one person assigned to answer questions for the first 48 hours. That last one is the whole trick.

💬 Got five minutes?

Fix one stale page today. The next reader will thank you.

motion.name: spring-blob-in

motion.name: wiggle-emoji

name: Chinese Ink Brush
intent: Shuimo washes, seal-stamp accents, horizontal scroll like a handscroll

description: A digital handscroll: content flows horizontally like a classical shuimo painting scroll, built from layered ink washes with generous breathing room and vermilion seal-stamp punctuation. motion.name: ink bleed
motion.detail: hero wash layer blurs from 8px→0 and opacity 0→1 over 1.2s ease-out on load

motion.name: horizontal glide
motion.detail: wheel input translates the scroll track 1:1 with 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) smoothing

motion.name: seal press
motion.detail: vermilion seals scale from 1.2 with slight rotation, 350ms cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1)

signature_elements: horizontal handscroll track with chapter seals
vermilion seal stamps as section markers
image_prompt: Website hero screen mockup: a Chinese tea house site as a horizontal handscroll. Left third shows layered gray ink-wash mountains fading to cream negative space; the center holds a large vertical Noto Serif SC headline with a vermilion seal stamp below. To the right, three thin scroll panels display tea vessels with colophon-style vertical captions. Brush-stroke divider under the hero. Muted, contemplative, red accent only. full webpage design, UI/UX, high detail, no watermark.

LAYOUT: implement a pinned horizontal-scroll track (GSAP ScrollTrigger, xPercent -60 over 3000px of vertical scroll, scrub 1) containing sections in order: (1) opening hero with ink-wash mountain SVG, vertical headline, and seal stamp; (2) tea origin chapter with three vessel images and colophon captions; (3) brewing timeline as a brush-stroke line with nodes; (4) about chapter with a long-form paragraph in wide measure; (5) closing vermilion seal and contact line. MOTION: brush-stroke SVGs draw in with stroke-dashoffset 900ms ease-in-out; the hero wash de-blurs from 8px/0-opacity over 1.2s on load; seals press in with a 350ms spring. SIGNATURE: (a) at least one vermilion seal per chapter used as a section marker, (b) vertical colophon captions beside images, (c) wide ma negative space between sections.
